title: A Traveller's Primer
author: The Wayfarers' Guild
pages: Welcome to the Haldmarch. This land is old, and full of people who live without you: they farm, build, marry, grieve and remember. Your journal lists the places you know of.

YOUR COMPANY. You do not travel alone: a few people have chosen to follow you and make a new home wherever you choose. They carry food, tools and timber. Lead them to good land (flat, water, trees, away from towns), then right-click with the Founding Charter, or talk to one of them and choose Settle here.

ORDERS. Your own people answer to you. Talk to one of them and choose: Help build (they lay blocks with the builders), Fell trees (the wood goes to the stores), Own trade, Come with me (they travel with you) or Go home. Until their workplace stands, everyone helps the builders anyway.
PEOPLE. Right-click anyone to talk, then click a topic: News (only what has reached them), Work (and what blocks them), Family, Life, Town. Look at someone to see their name and trade.
SETTLEMENTS. The hearthstone by the well tells a town's state. The storehouse ledger sells goods; use an item on it to sell it, sneak-use to give it freely.
NOTICES. The notice board holds news, wanted goods, contracts and bounties. Accept work there, then deliver to the storehouse. Bounties pay when an outlaw band is broken.
DANGER. Outlaws raid, but never without warning: first rumours, then scouts and smoke a day ahead, then bells at dusk. Towns keep their streets watched at night; the wilds do not.
STANDING. Trade, give and defend to earn standing. Once welcome, you may Join a town as a citizen. Crimes are remembered by those who saw them, and the watch has a long memory.
LAND. A Boundary Stone keeps settlement builders and woodcutters out of the land around it: 32 blocks in every direction.

FOUNDING. Once settled, your company pitches tents, then plans and builds for itself: fields first, a lumber camp, houses, a quarry. Bring logs, planks, stone and food to help, and ask for a building with /longnight plan. Without a company, a Founding Charter and a Hearthstone call three settlers.
WARDS. Kindle a Ward Stone with Ward Chalk (bone meal and flint) and the restless dead will not rise near it for three days.
The nights are longer than they were. The star-readers say it began in the Hollow beneath the world. Read what you find in ruins, but remember: not every book tells the truth.
